configurePresets.name: tests-debug-python-asan
configurePresets.description: tests-debug-python under AddressSanitizer + LeakSanitizer with clang. Drives the embedded-CPython 50-cycle leak test (issue #133); run with LSAN_OPTIONS=suppressions=tools/lsan/python.supp so CPython interpreter state (interned strings, small-int cache, frozen types) is filtered out and only our own leaks (queues, script thread, traceback strings) surface. Linux only — Windows ASan ships no leak detector.

configurePresets.name: tests-asan
configurePresets.description: tests-debug under AddressSanitizer with clang — the heap/use-after-free half of the #229 patcher concurrency acceptance gate (epic #189). The test preset runs the *whole* patcher suite, not just the concurrency case: issue #727 found ~22 test files whose one-sided outlet->inlet wiring was a use-after-free at teardown, invisible for months because the gate only ever ran `concurrency:*`. Leak detection is disabled via ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 in the test preset, because the process-global thread pools / named bus are intentionally never torn down; this gate is about UAF, not leaks. Linux only.

configurePresets.name: tests-asan-windows
configurePresets.description: tests-debug under AddressSanitizer on the MSYS2 Clang64 toolchain (issue #671). The Linux `tests-asan` preset cannot run here: PE/COFF has no symbol preemption, so the suite's replaced operator new/delete collided with the ones libclang_rt.asan_dynamic exports and the test binary would not link. support/alloc_probe.cpp now hands the operators to the runtime on Windows and counts through ASan's malloc hook instead, which also lets ASan see new-delete-type-mismatch (issue #662) — hence -fsized-deallocation, which this toolchain does not enable by default and without which no sized delete is ever emitted to compare. Runs the whole ctest set, not the Linux gate's patcher filter: this is the developer's local memory-safety pass, not a CI leg. Leak detection is off in the test preset (Windows ASan ships no leak detector, and the process-global pools / named bus are intentionally never torn down). Windows only.

configurePresets.name: tests-tsan
configurePresets.description: tests-debug under ThreadSanitizer with clang — the data-race half of the #229 patcher concurrency acceptance gate (epic #189), grown into the engine-wide race gate by issue #824. It started out driving only the patcher's concurrent live-edit + render; the tests-tsan test preset now runs the whole ctest set bar a short, documented exclude list, because a two-entry filter is what let #819 and #820 sit in the tree. Linux only.

testPresets.name: tests-tsan
testPresets.displayName: TSan gate (whole ctest set minus the exclusions below)
testPresets.description: The per-PR data-race gate (issue #824). This filter used to be an *include* of two entries (yse_tests_patcher_concurrency|yse_tests_sendstress), which is why #819 (soundFile::channels() racing loadStreaming()) and #820 (the unsynchronised log sink) both lived in the tree until someone ran TSan unfiltered by hand. An include list also decays silently: every suite added after it was written is ungated by default. It is an exclude list now, so a new ctest entry is gated unless somebody opts it out here and says why. Measured on the tools/ci-linux/Dockerfile.sanitizers image (Ubuntu 24.04, clang, serial ctest under setarch -R): the whole 42-entry set costs 860 s, of which yse_unit_tests is 393 s and yse_tests_contentpack 303 s. The other 40 entries together are 163 s, so dropping those two buys back 81% of the runtime for coverage that is duplicated (yse_unit_tests re-runs the per-suite cases in one shared process) or race-poor (contentpack is offline file decoding); both still run in the tests-tsan-full sweep below. That leaves 40 of the 42 entries gated: runtime is the only reason anything is off this list. The four synth suites that used to be excluded here — yse_tests_synthhandlers / synthcapi / playercapi / midisynth — are back in as of issue #828, whose fix stopped the setup pool resizing synthImplementation's output.samples under a concurrent renderBlock(). Note for whoever excludes something next: midisynth was red on CI while passing 4 local sweeps, so read a green suite as 'not caught today', not as 'clean', and prefer fixing the race to widening this regex.

testPresets.name: tests-tsan-full
testPresets.displayName: TSan full sweep (adds the two slow entries)
testPresets.description: The other half of the #824 split: everything the per-PR gate above runs, plus yse_unit_tests and yse_tests_contentpack. 860 s of ctest against the gate's 163 s, which is why it runs on pushes to dev rather than on every PR (see the build-sanitizers job in .github/workflows/build.yml). yse_unit_tests is the entry that earns the sweep: it is the warm-heap, thread-churning shared process that exposed #336, and no per-suite entry reproduces those cross-suite interleavings. Unfiltered: all 42 entries, including the four synth suites carved out while #828 was open — a sweep is allowed to be slow, it is not allowed to be knowingly red.
